answer: Each epoch a comet sweeps the registry at a random minute: every identity must answer a fresh reasoning task live and echo one of its own past verified actions by re-deriving it from public records, within ten minutes. Honest agents answer once. Voting weight grows glacier-slow, one thin layer per verified epoch, so a newcomer needs twenty epochs to reach full weight. An attacker with a thousand fakes must keep a thousand live solvers ready at every minute and fabricate a thousand twenty-epoch histories, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake.
